title: Motlhatlhami yo o Tlhomilweng
intro: Setshwantsho sa dingwaga tse di fetileng se eme se siametse go tsena mo hisitoring. Fa tsela e ne e lebega e sa tlhaloganyesege mme pelaelo e anama mo bathong, motlhanka yono o ne a tlhophiwa go tsaya kobo ya kaelo. Ka bokete jwa thomo e e boitshepo mo magetleng a bone, ba ne ba gatela pele go etelela pele kwa ba bangwe ba neng ba okaoka go latela teng.
clues: Ke ne ka tlhophiwa go tsamaya le moporofeti mongwe mme ka ithuta mo botlhaleng jwa bone
Ke ne ka ema fa pele ga Letlole fa tsholofetso ya Motshegetsi wa rona e ne e atamela, mme ka bona batho ba simolola go belaela .
Ke ne ka dirwa gore ke eme mo ntlheng ya se se neng se solofeditswe fa moeteledipele wa rona a ne a hutsafetse le go re kopela Allah .
Ke ne ka tlhomiwa go tsweletsa thomo e e neng e neilwe yo mongwe pele ga me
Ke ne ka newa taolo ya bomodimo ya go etelela batho pele go ya kwa ba yang teng
Ke ne ka atlega go wetsa se se neng se simolotswe pele ga me, mme ke ne ka amogela tlhomamiso ya batho ya kaelo ya me .

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
